'''2011 Bespin Regionals Ian C. LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ian C.]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)|VB6-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Women's Rights
* '''Username:''' Runner
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
